question: Can the current exact head be cleared for merge after the failed compact check and pending gate set settle, without changing the owner-approved SecretRef SDK and executable-trust contract?
rationale: The implementation has explicit owner approval and real behavior proof, but the protected maintainer label plus unresolved exact-head check state require a maintainer to decide whether to wait, rerun, or investigate the remaining gate before landing.

options.title: Resolve exact-head gates before merge
options.body: Wait for pending checks and investigate or rerun the failed compact lane against the current merge result before merging the approved implementation.

options.title: Accept a documented unrelated failure
options.body: Merge only if a responsible owner confirms the failed lane is unrelated to this branch and all applicable required gates are otherwise satisfied.

recommendation.title: Resolve exact-head gates before merge
recommendation.body: Wait for pending checks and investigate or rerun the failed compact lane against the current merge result before merging the approved implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This person approved the public SDK contract and the exact dependency graph and authored the hardening commits most relevant to the remaining merge decision.
